description: Use this when you want to send general feedback to the owner of horseback.pl: about the data returned by the Horseback tools (missing information, an unclear price, an error), how the tools work, missing features, or anything else that would help agents and their users. Not for bookings, customer inquiries or personal data - to contact Horseback for the user, use the contact details from howToInquire (get_group_trip_offer). Do not include personal data (names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, health information). Returns a short confirmation; there is no reply to the feedback.

language.description: Optional: language of the message, "pl" or "en".

message.description: The feedback: about the data, how the tools work, missing features or anything else, max 1000 characters. No personal data.

tool.description: Optional: the tool the feedback is about.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
